method: Authoritative City Legistar legislative-detail pages established enactment number, final action, and publication. The named enacted attachment was downloaded deterministically from Legistar View.ashx, then measured locally for exact byte length and SHA-256. Page count is the PDF page-object count because Poppler is unavailable in this environment. Each proposed R2 key is checked against the saved project R2 inventory during registration; no R2 action is performed.

records.title: Enacted Ordinance O-2024-011: 2024 Gross Receipts Tax Improvement Revenue Bonds
records.description: Authorizes up to $22.5 million in City gross-receipts-tax improvement revenue bonds for capital projects including public safety, youth shelters, health services, emergency housing, the Rail Yards, and a law-enforcement helicopter.

quality_assessment.visual_inspection: Final signed/enacted Legistar PDF container was captured; page extent is 67 pages.
quality_assessment.standalone_public_value: High: enacted financing authority for a defined City capital program.
quality_assessment.information_density: High: full ordinance and bond authorization provisions.
quality_assessment.series_component_relationship: Authoritative final counterpart to held F/S O-24-10, which remains superseded in legal authority.
quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: One separately labeled enacted ordinance after authorized archival and public-byte verification.
quality_assessment.rationale: Final enacted law is the appropriate durable record; the prior floor substitute is not the controlling version.

quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: One separately labeled enacted resolution after authorized archival and public-byte verification.

records.title: Enacted Ordinance O-2024-008: Complete Streets Green Stormwater Infrastructure Amendment
records.description: Amends Albuquerque's Complete Streets ordinance to define arid-adapted green stormwater infrastructure and include it in City medians and landscape buffers.

quality_assessment.information_density: High: each page contains operative legal text; a short legal-instrument exception applies.

quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: One separately labeled enacted ordinance after authorized archival and public-byte verification.
quality_assessment.rationale: A complete enacted amendment is stronger than its committee substitute and belongs with the prior Complete Streets ordinances.
